name: Hall food run
text: A union barge riding low with rations for a striking hall, her pilot down with fever. The steward at her helm, Teo Brandt, has flown her this far on a docker's licence and a prayer.

choices.label: Fly it, sign on Teo
choices.result: You fly her in on your pilot's hours. Teo stays aboard: the local can find another steward, he says, and you can't find another quartermaster.

choices.label: Fly the food run
choices.result: The hall eats tonight. Teo shakes every hand aboard, and the local pays what it can for the fuel.

choices.label: Take the rations
choices.result: A hold of union rations, and nobody to stop you but a docker at a helm. The halls will hear of it before you're out of the sector.

choices.label: Move on
choices.result: Teo waves you on, and goes back to reading the barge's manual.
